long_description:
Free 50-minute yoga class at the Ascension Saint Thomas Landing.

About this Event

Join Nashville Yards for a 50-minute Iconix yoga class at the Ascension Saint Thomas Landing, taught by Iconix instructor, Valentina Carrero.
Location: The Ascension Saint Thomas Landing at Nashville Yards
Address: West Garage Parking - 131 10th Ave N, Nashville, TN 37203
Cost: This class is free and open to the public (space is limited)

What to Bring: Water, Mat, and Sweat Towel
Parking Perk: Enjoy four hours of complimentary parking at the West Garage (131 10th Ave N). Just make sure you to scan the QR code at check-in.
Directions: After parking in the West Garage, take exterior elevators to level BR. The Ascension Saint Thomas Landing will be on your right.
